name: Onboarding completed_items_count must stay within [0, required_items_count] and equal required_items_count when status is completed.

payload.rationale: Onboarding completed_items_count must stay within [0, required_items_count] and equal required_items_count when status is completed.

response.expression: (((self.required_items_count >= 1) and (self.completed_items_count >= 0)) and (self.completed_items_count <= self.required_items_count)) and ((self.status != 'completed') or (self.completed_items_count == self.required_items_count))
